rows.notes: The study is a PRISMA systematic review with bibliometric analysis (VOSviewer) of 85 published articles on UAV thermal remote sensing for crop water status; it reports no own field, laboratory, survey or model data on thermal imaging/CWSI supporting irrigation timing and zoning, nor on fusion with multispectral data separating heat and nutrient stress. Its only 'results' are literature frequencies (crops, sensors, platforms, indices, algorithms, geographic distribution) and research gaps. Q1 is 'no' so Q2-Q9 are 'no'.

notes: Full text appears complete (abstract through references). The document is a systematic review/bibliometric synthesis, not a primary study.
